parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The database engine of the instance. Only Redis is supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the instance resides.

> This parameter does not affect the query results. You can specify any region ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-service-linked-role-exists --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine Redis --region cn-hangzhou
